scope: Actual UiState projection with synthetic fixtures; separate operational journey tests; no rendered/device acceptance
notes: Home and member detail remain content when child lists are empty.
Settings carries no financial snapshot, so stale timestamps alone do not expire it.
Authentication and screen guards override other display states, but unresolvedWarning is retained.
Conflicting record copies and parent frames are quarantined until online readback; unresolved journal warnings remain independent.
Composite snapshots keep the oldest known constituent timestamp; missing or future provenance fails closed.
RetryFreshnessChecks executes deferred-read, cache-fallback, parent-restoration and panel-freshness regressions in the actual ViewModel with doubles.
